legibility.token-contrast.note: Every semantic RBX_* fg/bg pair must meet WCAG AA. Never raise.

visual.hardcoded-color.note: No raw hex literals outside src/shared/design_tokens.rs and styles.rs. Never raise.

i18n.missing-key.note: Every key in resources/i18n/en.json must exist in every other locale. Never raise.

i18n.untranslated-screen.note: Ratchet. Baseline 2026-08-19: 37 of 108 DSL files ship copy that never goes through tr_key/tr_fmt. Lower this number as screens are translated; a PR that raises it must say why.

i18n.untranslated-value.note: Ratchet. Baseline 2026-08-19: 4 zh-CN values byte-identical to English (excluding locale-neutral strings). Lower as they are translated.
